extraction.notes: AVB reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null and recurring capex is not applicable. Table 3 appears on seq 11 (printed 9) and again on seq 39 (printed 22); figures are identical, seq 11 used. Share count 142,516,684 printed in full, divided by 1,000 to 142,516.684 thousands; reproduces FFO/share 2.88 (410,538/142,516.684) and Core FFO/share 2.74 (390,681/142,516.684). Zero-amount lines (distributions to NCI, casualty loss on real estate, loss on extinguishment, JV promote) are printed as dashes for Q3 2024 and are recorded as 0. Core adjustments categorised 'other' where no category fits: JV promote, SIP loan reserve, advocacy contributions, other real estate activity, for-sale condo imputed carry cost, income tax expense. Adjustments sum to the printed subtotals.
